title: Exit discharge doors.
officialText: At doors serving as exit discharge, a sign in compliance with Section 1024.2.6.1.1 shall contain supplemental directional text such as “FINAL EXIT,” “EXIT THROUGH LOBBY,” or “EXIT TO STREET” in sans serif letters one-half as high as the word EXIT. Exit discharge door sign shall comply with Figure S101.1(13) in Appendix S.
